summary: Enhanced buildNightwatchPrompt() in src/cron/nightwatch.ts with four changes: (1) Added senior code reviewer preamble before 'Perform a thorough analysis' that frames output as a goal description for the planning system. (2) Added broadened guidance to section 4 (Cross-workflow consistency): 'This is one example pattern — look broadly for any good practice that exists in one workflow but is missing from analogous workflows.' (3) Added new section 6 (Nightwatch self-maintenance) before the Output section, instructing the nightwatch to verify its own Key files references are still accurate and flag stale paths. (4) Added format guidance at end of Output section: 'Format your output as a single coherent goal description, not as raw JSON. The planning system will decompose it into steps.' pnpm build and pnpm lint both pass with 0 errors.
